boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UF spaces for studying, gathering, recreation, and a quiet pause—each supported by a direct university, library, museum, or RecSports source.

cards.title: Plaza of the Americas
cards.subtitle: Historic campus green by Library West
cards.notes: Use the benches and lawn for an outdoor reset, then look for the historic live oaks that mark the Plaza’s 1931 dedication.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped historic green framed by UF’s early Collegiate Gothic campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UF Libraries documents the Plaza as a social space for studying, organization recruitment, special events, and conversation.
cards.source_title: The Plaza of the Americas: A Place for…
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted event and campus-use guidance.

cards.title: Reitz Union
cards.subtitle: 686 Museum Road
cards.notes: Meet a group in the union, then use its wayfinding map to locate the Game Room, Arts & Crafts Center, gallery, dining, or student services.
cards.short_summary: UF’s student union combines gathering areas, recreation, services, and event space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Reitz Union describes itself as a space where students gather, collaborate, and exchange ideas, with recreation and student-service areas.
cards.access_notes: Individual areas, services, events, and reservations may have separate access rules or charges.

cards.title: Marston Science Library
cards.subtitle: 444 Newell Drive
cards.notes: Choose a collaboration floor for a group session or head to the fourth or fifth floor when you need a designated silent study area.
cards.short_summary: A science library with reservable rooms, technology lending, and distinct group and silent-study floors.
cards.evidence_claim: UF Libraries identifies Marston’s first through third floors for group study and its fourth and fifth floors for silent individual study.
cards.access_notes: Study-room reservations and library policies apply; check current library access information before visiting.

cards.title: Library West
cards.subtitle: 1545 West University Avenue
cards.notes: For focused work, use the fourth-floor quiet area; for collaboration, reserve a group room in advance rather than studying there solo.
cards.short_summary: The humanities and social-sciences library offers both quiet study and reservable group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Library West lists a fourth-floor quiet-study area and eighteen group study rooms intended for groups of two or more.
cards.access_notes: Group rooms require reservations; the graduate floor has Gator 1 access restrictions.

cards.title: Southwest Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: 3150 Hull Road
cards.notes: Plan a movement break around the indoor track, courts, cardio areas, or social lounge, and check the facility’s current hours before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A large RecSports facility with fitness equipment, courts, track, activity rooms, and a social lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: UF RecSports lists strength and conditioning, basketball courts, cardio space, an indoor track, activity rooms, and a social lounge at SWRC.
cards.access_notes: RecSports access and day-pass requirements apply; current weekday hours are listed as 5:30 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Student Recreation & Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: 244 Fletcher Drive
cards.notes: Use this central RecSports stop for basketball, volleyball, racquetball, squash, cycling, or a short strength-and-cardio session.
cards.short_summary: A central-campus recreation facility with courts, activity rooms, and fitness spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UF RecSports lists a multipurpose gym, strength room, activity rooms, cycle studio, cardio equipment, racquetball courts, and squash courts.
cards.access_notes: RecSports access and day-pass requirements apply; verify operating hours before visiting.

cards.title: Harn Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: UF Cultural Plaza
cards.notes: Walk the rotating galleries for an art-focused break, and consider Thursday’s extended Art After Dark hours when they fit your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A campus art museum with African, Asian, modern and contemporary art, photography, and changing exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Harn states that admission to its exhibitions and programs is free and that its galleries feature rotating exhibitions and collection areas.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Harn Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; the museum posts current hours, including Thursday evening Art After Dark hours.

cards.title: Baughman Center
cards.subtitle: 982 Museum Road, beside Lake Alice
cards.notes: Visit on a weekday for a quiet indoor pause; do not enter when private-event signs are posted, and respect the site’s event and parking rules.
cards.short_summary: A lakeside contemplation space with prominent windows and natural materials.
cards.evidence_claim: UF Performing Arts says the Baughman Center is open to the public for private contemplation on weekdays and hosts private events at other times.
cards.access_notes: Public contemplation hours: Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; Friday 8 a.m.–3 p.m.; closed weekends, holidays, and home football games.

cards.title: Lake Alice Field
cards.subtitle: South of Museum Road, across from Fraternity Row
cards.notes: Check the RecSports schedule or reservation status before heading over; the field is set aside for organized intramural, ROTC, and special-event use.
cards.short_summary: A named RecSports field within the Lake Alice area for organized campus activities.
cards.evidence_claim: UF RecSports states that Lake Alice Field is used by intramural sports and ROTC and may be reserved for special events.
cards.access_notes: Not an open-recreation field; use depends on scheduled activities and reservations.

cards.title: Florida Pool
cards.subtitle: Outside the Student Recreation & Fitness Center
cards.notes: Bring proper swim attire and a valid Gator 1 card, then confirm weather and lifeguard hours before planning a lap-swim or recreation session.
cards.short_summary: An eight-lane, 50-yard outdoor pool beside the Student Recreation & Fitness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UF RecSports identifies Florida Pool as an eight-lane, 50-yard outdoor pool and requires a valid Gator 1 Card for pool entry.
cards.access_notes: Valid Gator 1 Card required; swimming is allowed only while a lifeguard is on duty and hours can change with weather.
